questions.stem: In electroplating, which electrode should the object to be plated be connected to?

options.text: Either electrode will work equally well
It should not be connected to either electrode but placed in the middle

questions.explanation: The object to be plated must be connected as the cathode (negative electrode). This is because metal ions from the electrolyte are positive and are attracted to the cathode, where they gain electrons and deposit as a metal coating on the object.

questions.stem: When silver plating a steel spoon, what should be used as the electrolyte?
questions.explanation: The electrolyte must contain ions of the plating metal. Since the spoon is being silver plated, the electrolyte must contain silver ions, so silver nitrate solution (AgNO₃) is used. The silver ions in solution are attracted to the cathode (the spoon) where they deposit as a thin silver coating.
